project.title: Native own-session listing and revocation
project.goal: List own nonbearer sessions and atomically sign out or revoke selected/other/all own sessions with current authorization and audit
project.scope: R04/R41 internal admitted-control session lifecycle; no endpoint/provider/physical admission/cutover

boundary.responsibility: Resolve runtime-bound current session and atomic own-session listing/revocation/clear results
boundary.rationale: Rust identity needs usable session lifecycle and reliable deletion-based revocation
excludes: Endpoints, physical handle/lifetime admission, OAuth/cache/provider logout and full identity parity

action.session_control.description: List/sign out/revoke own current sessions with runtime-bound proof and deletion-based authority

errors.refused: Opaque invalid_credentials, invalid_control, invalid_request, session_listing_limit, connection/crypto/clock/config errors; NotCommitted or OutcomeUnknown with explicit reuse, no committed Rejected

preconditions: Caller owns actually admitted control/workspace lifetime; injected runtime signer/clock/audit config, no request subject claims
List/revokes require current fresh verified active human/factor; logout only bound proof/exact row with separate pure local clear
postconditions: Own intended deletions/lifecycle/audit atomically commit before result; source-compatible current row readers refuse revoked tokens
Listing excludes tokens and is bounded/stably sorted; operational rollback/commit uncertainty never assert false successful revocation
external_effects: Canonical own session deletion/lifecycle triggers plus native_session_control_v1 append-only workspace_audit event; header output only after known commit

authorization.rationale: Current operation-specific authority and serialized own-session rows/audit before disclosure; real deletions invalidate pending MFA. Unknown commits require reconciliation, never resurrection or blind replay.
